description: This file defines the 'Call' class, a model representing a call or appointment in the SuiteCRM system. It extends SugarBean and includes methods for managing call records, retrieving related contacts and users, handling notifications, and enforcing ACL permissions.

classes.name: Call
classes.description: Represents a call/appointment entity within SuiteCRM, including properties for call details and methods for managing related records, notifications, and permissions.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Call object and sets up custom fields and field mapping.

methods.name: ACLAccess
methods.description: Controls access permissions for editing or deleting calls, especially handling recurring calls from Outlook.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the call record, calculates end time, handles notifications, and updates vCal cache.

methods.name: removeUnInvitedFromReminders
methods.description: Filters out invitees who are no longer valid from reminder data.

methods.name: get_contacts
methods.description: Retrieves contacts related to this call.

methods.name: get_summary_text
methods.description: Returns a string summary of the call, mainly its name.

methods.name: create_list_query
methods.description: Builds SQL query for listing calls with complex joins and conditions.

methods.name: create_export_query
methods.description: Creates SQL query for exporting call data, optionally including contacts.

methods.name: fill_in_additional_detail_fields
methods.description: Populates additional fields like contact name based on related contact ID.

methods.name: get_list_view_data
methods.description: Prepares formatted data for list view display, including status coloring and contact info.

methods.name: create_notification_email
methods.description: Generates an email notification with an iCal calendar invite attachment.

methods.name: set_notification_body
methods.description: Fills in email notification template with call details and acceptance links.

methods.name: get_call_users
methods.description: Retrieves users associated with the call including their required and acceptance statuses.

methods.name: get_invite_calls
methods.description: Retrieves calls the user is invited to, with status filters.

methods.name: set_accept_status
methods.description: Sets the acceptance status for a user or contact regarding this call.

methods.name: get_notification_recipients
methods.description: Returns a list of users, contacts, and leads to notify about call updates.

methods.name: bean_implements
methods.description: Checks if the bean supports a given interface, e.g., ACL.

methods.name: listviewACLHelper
methods.description: Determines ACL-based display options for list views, including security group checks.

methods.name: save_relationship_changes
methods.description: Saves related records, excluding certain fields during import or SOAP calls.

methods.name: getDefaultStatus
methods.description: Returns the default status for new calls, based on field definitions.

methods.name: mark_deleted
methods.description: Handles deletion of the call, including adjusting recurrence data.
